metric_configuration.pixel_preprocessing: channel-last RGB; uint8 intensity [0,255]; no resizing

metric_configuration.optical_flow: OpenCV Farneback; estimated-field difference, not ground-truth endpoint error

metric_configuration.action_states: annotation states are 7D; first 3 dimensions used for translation step
metric_configuration.cross_view_object_agreement: pairwise category-set Jaccard; synchronized source frames; both-empty pairs excluded

cross_view_feature_consistency.metric: mean pairwise cosine similarity across synchronized views

fvd.frame_alignment: exact frame_indices or contiguous start_frame_index fallback; first sorted trajectory chunk wins overlaps; duplicate indices removed; gaps split clips

fid.weights: explicit local file or existing Torch-Fidelity cache; no downloads

preprocessing.action_alignment: explicit frame_indices; safe contiguous fallback from start_frame_index

warnings: Pixel fidelity is not evidence of physical understanding.
Image-space overlap and flow metrics are not verified 3D physical measurements.
Action-motion correlation is descriptive and is not causal evidence.
Gripper transition agreement is synchronized-series descriptive only, not causal evidence.
Cross-view category agreement is limited by detector labels and per-view visibility; it is not object identity or 3D agreement.
ResNet-50 cross-view feature similarity is a semantic proxy, not geometric correspondence.
FID and FVD are recomputed from all current inputs on every run/resume; global distribution results are never restored from sample checkpoints.
